from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from lxml import etree
import shutil, tempfile, os, re

path = Path('/home/user/Desktop/LibreOffice_Open_Source_Word_Processing.docx')
backup = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + '.bak')
shutil.copy2(path, backup)

NS = {
    'w': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main',
    'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'ct': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types',
    'rel': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships',
}
W = '{%s}' % NS['w']
R = '{%s}' % NS['r']
REL = '{%s}' % NS['rel']
CT = '{%s}' % NS['ct']
XML = '{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}'

with ZipFile(path, 'r') as zin:
    files = {info.filename: zin.read(info.filename) for info in zin.infolist()}
    infos = {info.filename: info for info in zin.infolist()}

# Choose unused footer name.
footer_nums = []
for name in files:
    m = re.fullmatch(r'word/footer(\\d+)\\.xml', name)
    if m:
        footer_nums.append(int(m.group(1)))
footer_num = max(footer_nums, default=0) + 1
footer_name = f'word/footer{footer_num}.xml'
footer_target = f'footer{footer_num}.xml'

rels_root = etree.fromstring(files['word/_rels/document.xml.rels'])
ids = []
for rel in rels_root.findall(f'{REL}Relationship'):
    rid = rel.get('Id', '')
    if rid.startswith('rId') and rid[3:].isdigit():
        ids.append(int(rid[3:]))
rid = f'rId{max(ids, default=0) + 1}'
etree.SubElement(rels_root, f'{REL}Relationship', Id=rid,
                 Type='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/footer',
                 Target=footer_target)
files['word/_rels/document.xml.rels'] = etree.tostring(rels_root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

ct_root = etree.fromstring(files['[Content_Types].xml'])
part_name = f'/word/footer{footer_num}.xml'
if not ct_root.xpath(\"ct:Override[@PartName="'$part]", namespaces=NS, part=part_name):
    etree.SubElement(ct_root, f'"'{CT}Override', PartName=part_name,
                     ContentType='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.footer+xml')
files['[Content_Types].xml'] = etree.tostring(ct_root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

# Footer with a live PAGE field, left-aligned.
footer_root = etree.Element(f'{W}ftr', nsmap={'w': NS['w'], 'r': NS['r']})
p = etree.SubElement(footer_root, f'{W}p')
pPr = etree.SubElement(p, f'{W}pPr')
etree.SubElement(pPr, f'{W}jc', {f'{W}val': 'left'})
for kind, text in [
    ('begin', None),
    (None, ' PAGE '),
    ('separate', None),
    ('text', '1'),
    ('end', None),
]:
    run = etree.SubElement(p, f'{W}r')
    if kind in ('begin', 'separate', 'end'):
        etree.SubElement(run, f'{W}fldChar', {f'{W}fldCharType': kind})
    elif kind == 'text':
        t = etree.SubElement(run, f'{W}t')
        t.text = text
    else:
        instr = etree.SubElement(run, f'{W}instrText', {f'{XML}space': 'preserve'})
        instr.text = text
files[footer_name] = etree.tostring(footer_root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

# Link every section to the footer for default, first, and even pages.
doc_root = etree.fromstring(files['word/document.xml'])
sect_prs = doc_root.findall('.//w:sectPr', namespaces=NS)
if not sect_prs:
    body = doc_root.find('w:body', namespaces=NS)
    sect = etree.SubElement(body, f'{W}sectPr')
    sect_prs = [sect]

for sect in sect_prs:
    for old in list(sect.findall('w:footerReference', namespaces=NS)):
        sect.remove(old)
    insert_at = 0
    for typ in ('default', 'first', 'even'):
        ref = etree.Element(f'{W}footerReference', {f'{W}type': typ, f'{R}id': rid})
        sect.insert(insert_at, ref)
        insert_at += 1

files['word/document.xml'] = etree.tostring(doc_root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)

fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.docx', dir=str(path.parent))
os.close(fd)
try:
    with ZipFile(tmp_name, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        written = set()
        for name, data in files.items():
            info = infos.get(name)
            if info is not None:
                zout.writestr(info, data)
            else:
                zout.writestr(name, data)
            written.add(name)
    os.replace(tmp_name, path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp_name):
        os.unlink(tmp_name)

print(f'added {footer_name} via {rid}; sections updated: {len(sect_prs)}')
print(f'backup: {backup}')

 3. Define the chapter’s unique style (different from this first
page style) as the style to follow this ‘first page’ style.
4. Insert a ‘manual break’ and apply the style to it.

With that done, you’ll now insert headers and footers to your different
pages. Once added, that style (which now includes a header/footer),
will persist. You can then repeat this process, weaving together styles
from page to page to define the layout and elements on each page.

It works. And Libre Office’s process might be a tiny bit tidier than
Word’s own means of using styles and sections to define header
content. But only just. Neither tool offers the kind of control over page
layout I’d like for my book files.

Design Elements
Once I got some headers inserted that I was moderately happy with, I
played with the other design options. Managing elements like images,
tables, columned text, and even drop caps were all pretty simple.

8

 Again, Libre Office focuses on styles. For example, I created a copy of
the basic body style and made it ‘body + drop cap’ and just applied this
style to the first paragraph of each chapter. The drop caps worked
perfectly.

I also found layering in images and charts worked quite well. Word
often presents overlapping or poorly spaced content when layering.
I’ve seen this particularly if I’m doing two or three-column designs
that include an image that spans multiple columns, like a magazine
page might include. Libre Office did get hung up on a couple of image
inserts I performed, but more often than with Word, I was able to
quickly fix the problem and continue working.
